text.zh_cn: 钥匙插入书台、等待建造完成后，右键书台选择从头开始或从最新记录点进入。
text.en_us: Insert a key and wait for construction. Right-click the lectern to start over or enter from the latest checkpoint.

text.zh_cn: 进入节点后完成当前目标。节点完成后，跟随出口前往下一节点；示例中的僵尸代表敌人。
text.en_us: Complete the current node's objective, then follow its exit to the next node. The zombie represents an enemy.

text.zh_cn: 遇到分歧时，走入可用的亮门选择航路。记录点解锁后可用于后续返场；信标仅代表记录点。
text.en_us: At a branch, enter an available lit gate to choose a route. An unlocked checkpoint can be used to return later; the beacon represents it.

text.zh_cn: 完成最终节点后结算离场；再次从书台出击时，可选择继续或重新开始。
text.en_us: Complete the final node to settle and leave. On a later sortie from the lectern, choose to continue or restart.
